rules.title: Sun-Moon conjunction (same sign)
refs: TA p.88 [printed 58] Section 25 'Relationship effect of each planet with other' - SUN WITH MOON
rules.verdict: Bullish if tithi happen to be Amavasya else Bearish
rules.rule: Sun and Moon are conjunction (same sign) to each other by whole sign.
rules.calc: Whole-sign distance between the two sidereal (Lahiri) signs; window opens/closes at the sign ingress that changes the distance (1-hour scan, bisected to 30 s).
quals: Moon relationships: TA itself flags Moon-only conditions as low reliability ('RELIABILITY VERY LOW AS MOON ALONE DOES NOT DRIVE THE MARKETS', TA p.67/p.68).

rules.title: Mercury in middle of Sun (ahead) and Venus (behind)
refs: TA p.49-50 [printed 19-20] Section 9 'Mercury in middle of Sun & Venus'
KD p.126/127 (4 & 14 Nov 2026: 'Sun ahead, Venus behind, Mercury in the middle')
rules.rule: Sun ahead, Venus behind, and Mercury between them in zodiacal longitude.
rules.calc: Signed arcs from Venus: Sun-Venus > 0 and 0 < Mercury-Venus < Sun-Venus. Validated against every dated example in TA/KD: 2014 (15 Feb-26 Apr; TA 'middle of February till end of April'), 2017 (20 Apr-21 Jun; 26 Aug-8 Oct), 2020 (1 Jul-17 Aug; TA '1st July to 18th August'), 2026 (from 4 Nov; KD 4 Nov).
quals: TA p.49: 'In 2016 this yog got muted in February because Rahu was passing from Jupiter star in D9 charts'.
TA p.50: in 2017 'got muted after 21st September due to Sun's 3rd aspect on Ketu till 29th September'.
TA p.262: 'whether market will be continuous Bullish or rising in a flat mode will depend on many other events'.

rules.title: Mercury in middle of Venus (ahead) and Sun (behind) - contra rule
rules.verdict: Bearish ('markets find it very tough to survive on the highs & frequent fall keep on happening')
rules.rule: Venus ahead, Sun behind, Mercury between them.
rules.calc: Signed arcs from Venus: Sun-Venus < 0 and Sun-Venus < Mercury-Venus < 0. Validated: 2018 (21 Sep-15 Oct; TA 21.09-16.10.2018), 2020 (10 Jan-26 Feb; TA 11 Jan-26 Feb). TA's first 2018 example (18.02-21.03.2018) computes as 17 Feb-4 Mar and 20 Mar-1 Apr (Mercury passed Venus in between).
quals: TA p.256 NOTE: whether markets will fall continuously or the fall will be flat depends on many other Planets & situations.

rules.title: Mercury Paap Kartari Yog (TA definition)
refs: TA p.128 [printed 98] Section 31 'Mercury Paap Kartari Yog'
rules.verdict: Bearish for Market in General & Banks in particular; USD & Dollar index strong
rules.rule: Mercury alone between two malefic planets AND the planet ahead of Mercury is retrograde.
rules.calc: Nearest graha ahead and behind Mercury in longitude (Moon and outers excluded); both TA malefics (Sun, Mars, Saturn, Rahu, Ketu); the one ahead retrograde (Rahu/Ketu always).
quals: CONFLICT: the 2026 document's B116 has no 'planet ahead retrograde' condition and counts Uranus/Pluto as malefics; this TA definition is stricter. Both are kept: B116 rows stay as they are, this rule is listed separately.
TA p.22 example (28 Oct 2011 - 2 Jan 2012) is NOT reproduced by this definition: it computes 6-26 Dec 2011 (Saturn behind, Rahu ahead), inside TA's window.

rules.title: Day lord and Nakshatra lord the same
rules.rule: The weekday's lord equals the lord of the Moon's nakshatra (Wednesday: Mercury & Rahu; Thursday: Jupiter, Ketu - as printed).
rules.calc: Moon's nakshatra at New York sunrise of each civil day (Hindu day runs sunrise to sunrise); Vimshottari lords (TA p.47-48).
quals: Indian practice reads the nakshatra at the local (Indian) sunrise; this edition uses New York sunrise. Days near a nakshatra change can differ between the two.

rules.title: Aries: Sun or Mars present with Saturn & Rahu
refs: TA p.54 [printed 24] Section 13 'Bullish Bearish nature of zodiac signs' - Aries (Bullish)
rules.rule: In Aries (sign type: Bullish): Sun or Mars present with Saturn & Rahu.  (R) means retrograde.
rules.calc: Sidereal (Lahiri) whole sign of the body; window bounded by its ingresses. 'Any 2' = at least two of the listed bodies in the sign at once, each meeting its (R) condition. Retrograde = of-date longitudinal speed < 0 (station instants as almanacs define them); Rahu/Ketu always retrograde (TA p.73).
quals: TA footer: (R) MEANS RETROGRADE.

rules.title: Mercury combustion type (7 types)
rules.verdict: Prakrita - Bearish; Vimishra - Medium; Sankshipta, Tikshna, Ghora, Papa, Yogantika - Bullish
rules.rule: Mercury combustion type (7 types).
rules.calc: Combustion (asta) and rise (udaya) dates from the astronomy layer's kalamsha method at Mumbai (date-granular; the 2026 document's convention); East/West as the layer records it.
quals: Type assigned from the combustion's length in days using midpoints between the printed nominal durations (40/30/22.5/18/15/10.5/9); TA p.26 calls Prakruta a 'speed of Mercury', so the type is a speed class and the length is its proxy.
TA p.70: If combustion Bullish but aspected by malefic - Bearish; if Bearish but aspected by benefic - Bullish.
TA p.70: If combust in direct motion: starts Bearish but Bullish after conjunction with Sun; if combust in retrogression it is Bullish.
TA p.70: Bullishness returns after speed of Mercury crosses speed of Venus (see 'Mercury Manifestation').
Combust/rise dates are civil dates, not instants: the event is date-only.

rules.title: Panchak (Moon in Dhanishta 3rd pada to Revati)
rules.verdict: #6 starts Mon/Wed/Fri Bearish; #7 Sun/Tue/Thu/Sat Bullish; #3 starts & ends 50 ghadi after sunrise Bullish for one year; #4 45 ghadi Bullish for the month; #5 other times Bearish for that fortnight; #8 Indra, Vaidhrati or Vyatipat yog on Panchak days high Bullish
rules.rule: Moon from 0deg Aquarius (Dhanishta pada 3) to the end of Revati.
rules.calc: Moon's sidereal longitude >= 293deg20'; ghadi counted from New York sunrise (1 day = 60 ghadi, 1 hour = 2.5 ghadi, TA p.77).
quals: TA p.77 bottom NOTE: 1, 3 & 8 ARE HIGH PROBABLE, THE REST DEPEND ON MANY OTHER FACTORS.
Rules #1/#2 ('If all five Panchak Bullish/Bearish') are not computed: the book does not say what makes one Panchak day bullish.

refs: TA p.121-122 [printed 91-92] Section 28 'Bhadra & its effect' (Muhurta Chintamani)
rules.verdict: Earth (Cancer, Leo, Aquarius, Pisces) - negative & sentimental Bearish; heaven/hell - no effect, beneficial. Day Bhadra in day time / night Bhadra in night time - Negative; day Bhadra in night / night Bhadra in day - Positive
rules.rule: Each Vishti karana: Moon's sign at its start fixes the loka; Day Bhadra = Shukla 8/15, Krishna 7/14; Night Bhadra = Shukla 4/11, Krishna 3/10.
rules.calc: Vishti karana spans from the astronomy layer (6deg elongation steps); Moon sign at the start; share of the window between New York sunrise and sunset (>= 50% = day time).
quals: 'Starts in' read as the Moon's sign at the Bhadra's start.
Day/night judged at New York; Indian timing differs by ~10 h.

rules.title: Sun-Ketu Vedha
refs: TA p.140-141 [printed 110-111] Section 32 E 'Specific Vedha & their results'
rules.rule: Sun does Vedha to the nakshatra Ketu occupies on the Sarvatobhadra wheel (TA pp.131-133).
rules.calc: Each body's nakshatra (28-name scheme with Abhijit); vedha side per finastro/pdfref/vedha.py (TA p.134 rules + 2026 class doctrine, TA p.144 normal speeds); window while the target nakshatra is occupied.
quals: TA p.136: when 2 planets do Vedha of each other it is strong Vedha (impact high); Vedha by the Sun on Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus or Saturn is weak; Moon below 8 deg or above 22 deg is weak.
TA p.137 #5: when Vedha ends with Bearish implications it reverses the trend.
Direction doctrine conflict between TA p.134 and the 2026 tables: see vedha.py and REFERENCE_PDF_RULES.md.

rules.title: Sun in a Venus, Mercury or Jupiter nakshatra (user note)
rules.rule: Sun in Bharani, Purva Phalguni, Purva Ashadha (Venus), Ashlesha, Jyeshtha, Revati (Mercury), Punarvasu, Vishakha or Purva Bhadrapada (Jupiter).
rules.calc: Sidereal (Lahiri) nakshatra of the body, 27 x 13deg20'; window = the residency, boundaries bisected to 30 s. Lords per Vimshottari (TA pp.47-48).
quals: Gold is ruled by the Sun (user note; TA S29 lists no gold sector, the PDFs' gold rules are mostly Sun placements).

Conflict: TA p.155 S34 A10 lists Sun on Bharani, Krittika, Punarvasu and Pushya as gold-RALLY stars (Pushya is a Saturn nakshatra), 'not aspected by Benefic - More Bullish if aspected by Malefic'; TA p.156 S34 B1: Sun on Anuradha (Saturn nakshatra) with or aspected by a benefic - gold can fall. Both sources are shown.

rules.title: Venus, Mercury, Jupiter or waxing Moon with / aspecting the Sun (user note)
rules.rule: Venus, Mercury or Jupiter in the Sun's sign or casting drishti on it, or the Moon doing so during Shukla paksha.
rules.calc: Sidereal (Lahiri) whole sign of the body; window bounded by its ingresses. Waxing = Shukla paksha (elongation 0-180 deg). Window changes whenever the set of contacts changes.
quals: Aspect = whole-sign graha drishti (Jupiter 5/7/9, Saturn 3/7/10, Rahu 7 - project convention; Rahu's 7th falls on Ketu's sign); conjunction = same sign. Venus and Mercury can only conjoin the Sun (they never get far enough to aspect it).

Conflict: TA p.154 S34 A3 and the 2026 document's gold-bullish #2 make the Sun in Libra with/aspected by malefics (Saturn, Mars, Rahu) BULLISH for gold, and TA S34 A10 says a malefic aspect makes the Sun's rally stars MORE bullish; TA S34 B1 makes a benefic with the Sun on Anuradha bearish. Both sources are shown.
Mercury is never more than ~28 deg from the Sun, so it shares the Sun's sign for long stretches of the year.

rules.title: Sun in a Saturn or Rahu nakshatra (user note)
rules.verdict: Can trigger fall in gold prices (Bearish)
rules.rule: Sun in Pushya, Anuradha, Uttara Bhadrapada (Saturn) or Ardra, Swati, Shatabhisha (Rahu).
rules.calc: Sidereal (Lahiri) nakshatra of the body, 27 x 13deg20'; window = the residency, boundaries bisected to 30 s. Lords per Vimshottari (TA pp.47-48).
quals: Gold is ruled by the Sun (user note; TA S29 lists no gold sector, the PDFs' gold rules are mostly Sun placements).

Conflict: TA p.155 S34 A10 lists Sun on Bharani, Krittika, Punarvasu and Pushya as gold-RALLY stars (Pushya is a Saturn nakshatra), 'not aspected by Benefic - More Bullish if aspected by Malefic'; TA p.156 S34 B1: Sun on Anuradha (Saturn nakshatra) with or aspected by a benefic - gold can fall. Both sources are shown.
User note: 'fear, greed and market illusions are Rahu's territory'.

rules.title: Saturn or Rahu with / aspecting the Sun (user note)
rules.rule: Saturn or Rahu in the Sun's sign or casting drishti on it (Rahu's 7th = Sun with Ketu).
rules.calc: Sidereal (Lahiri) whole sign of the body; window bounded by its ingresses. Window changes whenever the set of contacts changes.
quals: Aspect = whole-sign graha drishti (Jupiter 5/7/9, Saturn 3/7/10, Rahu 7 - project convention; Rahu's 7th falls on Ketu's sign); conjunction = same sign. Venus and Mercury can only conjoin the Sun (they never get far enough to aspect it).

Conflict: TA p.154 S34 A3 and the 2026 document's gold-bullish #2 make the Sun in Libra with/aspected by malefics (Saturn, Mars, Rahu) BULLISH for gold, and TA S34 A10 says a malefic aspect makes the Sun's rally stars MORE bullish; TA S34 B1 makes a benefic with the Sun on Anuradha bearish. Both sources are shown.
User note: 'fear, greed and market illusions are Rahu's territory'.
